selected.rationale: Loss on compose-post->post-storage removes the core persistence dependency; a synchronous no-timeout/retry call will hang or fail the entire compose request, exposing missing timeout/retry protection on the primary write path.

Loss on compose-post->unique-id blocks ID generation, a mandatory prerequisite for every post, so all compose requests hang or fail if the edge lacks a timeout; this reveals a critical single-dependency weakness.

Loss on compose-post->home-timeline breaks fan-out propagation of new posts to followers; if compose-post waits without a bounded timeout, post creation blocks and the timeline write path becomes unavailable.

Loss on compose-post->user-timeline prevents the author timeline write, causing compose requests to fail or hang; this targets the core synchronous user-timeline dependency and exposes missing retry/timeout defenses.
Loss on home-timeline->post-storage breaks the feed read path, making home-timeline unable to retrieve post data; an unhandled synchronous call causes feed unavailability or unbounded latency.

Loss on compose-post->user removes the user lookup/validation dependency in the synchronous compose flow, causing post creation to fail or hang; this reveals missing timeout/retry on a mandatory user dependency.
Loss on compose-post->text stalls text processing in the synchronous compose path, failing post creation and exposing missing timeout/fallback for a content-processing edge.
Loss on compose-post->media makes media attachment handling fail; if media is in the workload, the compose request fails or hangs, revealing missing timeout/isolation for this dependency.
